countdownHoursMinutes.where: Dashboard hero card: countdown inside the "Starts in" badge when the next service is under 4 hours away
countdownHoursMinutes.context: {hours} and {minutes} are whole numbers; "h"/"m" are hour/minute abbreviations

countdownMinutes.where: Dashboard hero card: countdown inside the "Starts in" badge when the service is under an hour away
countdownMinutes.context: {minutes} is a whole number; "m" abbreviates minutes

urgencyUpcoming.where: Dashboard hero card: badge on the next setlist when it has no date

urgencyToday.where: Dashboard hero card and timeline: badge when the service is today

urgencyTomorrow.where: Dashboard hero card and timeline: badge when the service is tomorrow

startsIn.where: Dashboard hero card: badge shown when the next service starts within 4 hours

songCount.where: Dashboard hero card and service cards: number of songs in the setlist

chartsReviewed.where: Dashboard hero card: prep progress label above the progress bar
chartsReviewed.context: "chart" = sheet music; {viewed} charts opened out of {total}

percent.where: Dashboard hero card: prep progress percentage beside the progress bar

allChartsCached.where: Dashboard hero card: status when every chart is saved on the device for offline use
allChartsCached.context: "chart" = sheet music; {total} is the number of charts

chartsCachedProgress.where: Dashboard hero card: how many charts are saved on the device for offline use

downloadAllAria.where: Dashboard hero card: screen-reader label of the Download all button

downloading.where: Dashboard hero card: Download all button while charts are downloading

downloadAll.where: Dashboard hero card: button that saves every chart of the setlist for offline use

perform.where: Dashboard hero card and next-service card: action that opens the setlist in Perform mode
perform.context: Perform mode = the full-screen view used on stage

editSetlist.where: Dashboard hero card and next-service card: link/button label that opens the setlist editor

openSetlist.where: Dashboard hero card: main action that opens the next setlist

compactSongCount.where: Dashboard: compact setlist row, number of songs under the setlist name
compactSongCount.context: {count} is the number of songs. English shows "songs" even for 1 (current behaviour); translate the plural naturally

navLibrary.where: Dashboard command row: shortcut button to the chart library
navLibrary.context: "chart" = sheet music; the library is the collection of charts

navSetlists.where: Dashboard command row: shortcut button to the setlists list

navNew.where: Dashboard command row: shortcut button that starts a new setlist

onboardingInstrumentQuestion.where: Dashboard onboarding card: label above the instrument picker

onboardingSelectInstrument.where: Dashboard onboarding card: empty first option of the instrument picker

onboardingSaving.where: Dashboard onboarding card: save button while the instrument is being saved

onboardingSaveContinue.where: Dashboard onboarding card: button that saves the chosen instrument

onboardingSkip.where: Dashboard onboarding card: button that dismisses the instrument setup

onboardingWelcome.where: Dashboard onboarding card: heading for a newly signed-up user awaiting approval

onboardingPendingBody.where: Dashboard onboarding card: text under the welcome heading while the account is pending

onboardingSetUpMyInstrument.where: Dashboard onboarding card (pending account): button that opens the instrument picker

onboardingApprovedTitle.where: Dashboard onboarding card: heading once an admin has approved the account

onboardingApprovedBody.where: Dashboard onboarding card: text under "You're approved!"
onboardingApprovedBody.context: "chart" = sheet music; transposed = shown in the key of the musician's instrument

onboardingSetUpInstrument.where: Dashboard onboarding card (approved): button that opens the instrument picker

practiceRecommendations.where: Dashboard: heading of the nudge listing songs not yet reviewed before a service within 3 days

prepWhenToday.where: Dashboard practice recommendations: after a song title, when the service is today (shown as "Song — today")

prepWhenTomorrow.where: Dashboard practice recommendations: after a song title, when the service is tomorrow

prepWhenInDays.where: Dashboard practice recommendations: after a song title, days until the service (2 or 3 in practice)

moreUnreviewedCharts.where: Dashboard practice recommendations: footer when more than 3 songs are unreviewed
moreUnreviewedCharts.context: "chart" = sheet music; {count} is how many more. English keeps "charts" even for 1 (current behaviour)

setlistsUpdated.where: Dashboard "what changed" banner: heading when setlists changed since the last visit
setlistsUpdated.context: {count} is the number of changed setlists

changedSinceLastVisit.where: Dashboard "what changed" banner: line under the heading listing the changed setlists
changedSinceLastVisit.context: {setlistNames} is the list of quoted setlist names; {count} is how many

quotedSetlistName.where: Dashboard "what changed" banner: one setlist name in the list, in quotation marks
quotedSetlistName.context: {setlistName} is the setlist's name; use the language's quotation marks

listSeparator.where: Dashboard "what changed" banner: separator between setlist names in the list
listSeparator.context: A comma and a space; keep the trailing space

yourTasks.where: Dashboard: heading of the list of prep tasks assigned to the user (shown in CSS uppercase)

comingUp.where: Dashboard: heading of the upcoming-services timeline (shown in CSS uppercase)

updatedBadge.where: Dashboard timeline: small badge on a setlist changed since the user's last visit

viewedOfTotal.where: Dashboard timeline: prep progress beside the bar (charts reviewed out of total)
viewedOfTotal.context: {viewed} and {total} are numbers of charts (sheet music)

collapseTrackList.where: Dashboard timeline: screen-reader label of the chevron that hides a setlist's song list

expandTrackList.where: Dashboard timeline: screen-reader label of the chevron that shows a setlist's song list

errorTitle.where: Error screen for any signed-in page that crashed while loading: heading

errorBody.where: Error screen for a page that crashed while loading: text under the heading

errorRetry.where: Error screen: button that tries to load the page again

errorHardReset.where: Error screen: button that clears the app's saved local data and reloads the home page

loadErrorTitle.where: Dashboard: heading of the error box when the setlists could not be loaded (the technical error follows)

loadErrorHint.where: Dashboard: small hint under the setlist load error

noServicesYet.where: Dashboard: empty state when there is no upcoming or past setlist

diagSubscriptionReturned.where: Dashboard empty state: small monospace diagnostic line for support
diagSubscriptionReturned.context: Technical diagnostic for support; may stay in English. {count} setlists loaded; {fromCache} is true/false; {firedAt} is a time; {authUid}/{serverUid} are id prefixes. Keep the key=value parts verbatim

diagSubscriptionPending.where: Dashboard empty state: small monospace diagnostic line for support when nothing has loaded yet
diagSubscriptionPending.context: Technical diagnostic for support; may stay in English

recentSetlists.where: Dashboard: heading above the recent setlists list (shown in CSS uppercase)

signInOr.where: Dashboard sign-in box: word on the divider between the QR sign-in and the Google button (shown in CSS uppercase)

signInWithGoogle.where: Dashboard sign-in box: button that signs in with a Google account
signInWithGoogle.context: "Google" is a brand name, do not translate it

greetingGoodMorning.where: Dashboard: big greeting at the top before noon

greetingGoodAfternoon.where: Dashboard: big greeting at the top from noon to 5 pm

greetingGoodEvening.where: Dashboard: big greeting at the top after 5 pm

greetingShabbatShalom.where: Dashboard: big greeting from Friday 4 pm to Saturday 9 pm
greetingShabbatShalom.context: The everyday Shabbat greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingShanahTovah.where: Dashboard: big greeting on Rosh Hashanah
greetingShanahTovah.context: New Year greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingGmarChatimahTovah.where: Dashboard: big greeting on Yom Kippur
greetingGmarChatimahTovah.context: The usual Yom Kippur greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingChagSameach.where: Dashboard: big greeting on Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret/Simchat Torah and Shavuot
greetingChagSameach.context: Festival greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingChagUrimSameach.context: Hanukkah greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingChagPurimSameach.context: Purim greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingChagPesachSameach.context: Passover greeting (a greeting, not prayer text).

greetingWithName.where: Dashboard: the big greeting when the signed-in person's first name is known, e.g. 'Good morning, Dana'
greetingWithName.context: {greeting} is one of the dashboard.greeting* phrases; {firstName} is the person's first name.

welcomeTo.where: Dashboard: big greeting on a weekday when nobody is signed in
welcomeTo.context: {appName} is the congregation's short name (e.g. the music app's brand).
